## s18-v08 — argument map

Ever in Thy city, or parted and roaming — may I be by Thee (satatam eva tavaiva pure 'thavāpy arahito vicareyam ahaṃ tvayā). No moment's defeat where become of Thee (kṣaṇalavo 'py ... na vijaye nanu yatra bhavanmayaḥ).

### Open
- Triple negative (mā sma ... na ... nanu) is emphatic; L2 follows the already-victorious reading.
